parameter.name: apiKey
parameter.label: API Key
parameter.description: Create a key in the OnlyCat app: enable Developer Mode under Account, then open API Keys

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: How often to refresh door policies, cat names and reboot logs, which change without notification

parameter.name: rebootLogHours
parameter.label: Reboot Log Period
parameter.description: How many hours of reboot history to report

parameter.name: detailedMetrics
parameter.label: Detailed Metrics
parameter.description: Also fetch the telemetry metrics of each flap

parameter.name: deviceId
parameter.label: Device ID
parameter.description: The ID of the flap, such as OC-8C1F64481234

parameter.name: ignoreFlapStateRules
parameter.label: Ignore Flap State Rules
parameter.description: Leave door policy rules on the flap state out of the lock state estimate

parameter.name: ignoreMotionSensorRules
parameter.label: Ignore Motion Sensor Rules
parameter.description: Leave door policy rules on the motion sensors out of the lock state estimate

thing-type.label: OnlyCat Cat
thing-type.description: A cat known to the flaps of the account by its RFID code

parameter.name: rfidCode
parameter.label: RFID Code
parameter.description: The RFID code of the cat's microchip

channel-type.label: Connected
channel-type.description: Whether the flap is connected to the OnlyCat cloud

channel-type.label: Disconnect Reason
channel-type.description: Why the flap lost its connection

channel-type.label: Connectivity Changed
channel-type.description: When the flap last connected or disconnected

channel-type.label: Locked
channel-type.description: Estimated lock state derived from the door policy; undefined if it cannot be determined

channel-type.label: Door Policy Definition
channel-type.description: The active door policy as JSON

channel-type.label: Event Active
channel-type.description: Whether an event is in progress

channel-type.label: Event ID
channel-type.description: The ID of the latest event

channel-type.label: Event Time
channel-type.description: When the latest event started

channel-type.label: Event RFID Codes
channel-type.description: Comma-separated RFID codes seen in the latest event

channel-type.label: Event Cat
channel-type.description: Names of the cats seen in the latest event

channel-type.label: Contraband
channel-type.description: Whether the latest event was classified as contraband

channel-type.label: Human Activity
channel-type.description: Whether the latest event was classified as human activity

channel-type.label: Event Image
channel-type.description: A still frame of the latest event

channel-type.label: Event Video URL
channel-type.description: HLS playlist of the latest event; contains an access token

channel-type.label: Error
channel-type.description: Whether the flap logged an error reboot in the configured period

channel-type.label: Reboot Log
channel-type.description: The reboots in the configured period as JSON

channel-type.label: Telemetry
channel-type.description: The latest telemetry metrics as JSON, if detailed metrics are enabled

channel-type.label: Last Seen
channel-type.description: When the cat was last seen at a flap

channel-type.label: Last Flap
channel-type.description: The ID of the flap that last saw the cat

channel-type.label: Event Trigger
channel-type.description: What started the latest event

channel-type.label: Event Classification
channel-type.description: The classification of the latest event

channel-type.label: Direction
channel-type.description: The direction of the last movement at the flap

channel-type.label: Action
channel-type.description: What the cat did at the flap

channel-type.label: Door Policy
channel-type.description: The active door policy; send the name of a policy to activate it

channel-type.label: Remote Unlock
channel-type.description: Send ON to unlock the flap for a single passage

channel-type.label: Reboot
channel-type.description: Send ON to reboot the flap

channel-type.label: Presence
channel-type.description: Whether the cat is inside; send ON or OFF to correct it until the cat is next seen at a flap
